doc.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998

chapter: Opening and Kansas City head arrangements
title: Snooky's spoken ending and the Glee Club
summary: The Cheathams were shocked the track was released; Snooky blamed Jimmy for the spoken ending and later became the 'director' of the Glee Club again.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: We did it for fun. And so we thought it would be against the law or something. But they put it on the record.
Yeah, we thought they’d ban it. We were so surprised.
We were really shocked that it came out you know.
I really like the end too, you said — remember what you said at the end?
Snooky blamed Jimmy for a long time.
He blamed me, see, all the time.
He didn’t want his wife to know that he was there.

He didn’t want his wife to know that he said that, see? You know, so we had to cool it for a while, then all of a sudden, he got to liking it you know. So the next session, he became the director again —
